description: NaCaH₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded to five H atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaH₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Na-H bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.36 Å. Ca is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven H atoms. There are a spread of Ca-H bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.40 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ca atoms to form HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra that share corners with six HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent HNaCa₃ trigonal pyramids, and edges with three HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra. In the second H site, H is bonded to one Na and three equivalent Ca atoms to form HNaCa₃ trigonal pyramids that share corners with twelve HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent HNaCa₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent HNaCa₃ trigonal pyramids. In the third H site, H is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ca atoms to form HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra that share corners with six HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent HNaCa₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three HNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent HNaCa₃ trigonal pyramids.
